profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experience on both the iOS and Android platforms positions me as an expert software developer with a deep understanding of quality mobile apps. Working in large teams or solo, on complex or simple apps, for public or internal use, I have both the technical and non-technical skills that project and product managers appreciate: experience, talent, and reliability.

I am currently employed and not looking to make any changes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Mobile Application Development · Android · Android NDK · iOS · Objective-C · Java · Kotlin · Swift (Programming Language) · C++ · Android SDK · iOS Development · Android Development · Android Jetpack

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description: My primary responsibility is our mobile apps. We have 2 apps available for iOS and Android -- I am the lead engineer for both. I also do quite a bit of development on our web apps (Angular/Typescript), and I occasionally help out on our back-end (.NET, C#).
positions.insights: Skills: RxJava · Code Review · Swift (Programming Language) · Android Development · JUnit · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Kotlin · iOS Development · Optimization · Jenkins · Kotlin Coroutines · Test Automation · Communication · Android Jetpack · Android SDK · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Espresso · User Experience (UX) · REST APIs · Dagger (Software)
